The '''Ruins of Ullek''' are the remains of an ancient city located in the deep south of the [[Kharidian Desert]]. The area is visited during the [[Beneath Cursed Sands]] quest, where the player unlocks the [[Scabaras Dungeon|dungeon]] below.

== Transportation ==
There are several ways of reaching the ruins through teleports, listed here in order of least running to most:

* {{Plink|Pharaoh's sceptre}} — [[Agility Pyramid]] (Jaleustrophos).
* {{Plink|Fairy ring|pic=Fairy ring (Construction) icon}} {{Fairycode|AKP}} — Necropolis island. Requires 62 [[Agility]] and completion of [[Beneath Cursed Sands]].

* {{Plink|Nardah teleport}} — town centre, slightly east of the [[rug merchant]].
* {{Plink|Desert amulet 2|txt=Desert amulets}} — [[Elidinis Statuette|Temple of Elidinis]], slightly east of the [[rug merchant]].

* {{Plink|Construct. cape|txt=Construction cape}} — [[Pollnivneach]] house portal, north of the [[rug merchant]], then rug to Sophanem.

== History ==
During the [[God Wars]], the [[Battle_of_Ullek|city was destroyed]] by [[Zamorak]]ian invaders from the north, led by the demon [[Balfrug Kreeyath]].{{CiteText|text=Stone tablet (Beneath Cursed Sands)|quote=The Zamorakians are coming. We have no quarrel with them, but they won't care.}}{{CiteText|text=Balfrug Kreeyath|quote=Despoiler of Ullek.}} Today, only ruins remain where the once magnificent city stood, inhabited by [[scabarites]].

==Features==
Despite its small size, there are multiple areas for training within the ruins. With the exception of the small eastern area, however, all parts of the ruins require waterskins. The area has several [[Kharidian cactus]] spawns, however, which can be used to refill [[waterskin|waterskins]] used while training here.

=== Training ===

* There are five [[Teak tree|teak trees]] on the eastern side of the ruins, as well as two [[Crimson swift|crimson swifts]].
* A [[furnace]] and [[anvil]] can be found atop the ruins.
* The [[Ruins of Ullek mine]], just of the ruins, five [[Iron rocks|iron]], three [[Coal rocks|coal]], three [[Clay rocks|clay]], and one [[adamantite rock]].
